faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: What people ask most
faq.subtitle: Click a question to read the answer.

items.q: Do you do it for us?
items.a: No. We teach your team, and mentor the first real project on request. The knowledge stays with you.
Custom quote, based on group size and industry. Attractive compared to enterprise internal training day rates.

items.q: How do I know if we need RPA or AI?
items.a: You don't have to decide upfront – that's exactly what the method is for. It's decided after the process assessment, and sometimes it turns out neither is needed: a better Excel is enough.

items.q: Do we need a prior assessment for the workshop?
items.a: Not required. The workshop includes a focused assessment on your real processes.

items.q: What do we take home from the workshop?
items.a: Not a finished, audited process – but working knowledge of the method walked through on a real example, and the ability to continue.

items.q: What if it turns out we don't need automation?
items.a: That's also a result. Process improvement is a win in itself. We don't push automation when it doesn't pay.
